secrets_policy: Never store API keys, tokens, passwords, cookies, or personal data in this public repository. Connected provider credentials must remain in scoped GitHub Actions secrets or approved confidential service vault.
writer_policy: One active publishing writer per channel. Any second authorized Buffer account requires separate secrets, explicitly approved channel ownership and distinct channel mapping; never connect the same social account to two Buffer organizations.
media_policy: Do not mark PLANNED creative as APPROVED or PUBLISHED without exact licensed media asset and proof of actual platform result.

reporting_policy: A successful GitHub check including HELD_NO_APPROVED_ORIGINAL_MEDIA proves only safe nonpublication, not 18 daily live posts. The 7-day/42 concept IDs are editorial plans; daily Buffer schedule/native permalinks must be verified separately.
